name: Oya Browser
description: Drive a real Chrome browser through one API — on Oya Cloud, Browserbase, Steel, Anchor, Browser Use, or the user's own machine with their cookies, logins and extensions. Navigate, analyze pages as markdown, TOON or JSONL, click, type, screenshot, scroll and manage tabs. Personas keep a logged-in identity stable across runs and providers.

skills.name: Browser Automation
skills.description: Navigate to URLs, analyze page content, click elements, type text, take screenshots, scroll, and manage tabs in a real Chrome browser.
examples: Navigate to https://example.com and analyze the page
Click the login button and fill in the form
Take a screenshot of the current page

skills.name: Browser Pool
skills.description: Dispatch commands across multiple browsers with round-robin load balancing and shared cookie synchronization.
examples: Run the same search across 5 browsers in parallel
Check pool status and connected browsers
